body.statement: For every \(G\) and \(A,B,C\subseteq V\), \((A,B,C)\in\mathcal I_E(G)\) iff every \((\{a\},\{b\},C)\in\mathcal I_E(G)\), including diagonal queries and \(B\cap C\neq\varnothing\).
body.justification: It makes the full asymmetric model a finite singleton-oracle object.
body.gap: Right composition must handle the target-dependent conditioning set.
body.consumer: The recovery map stores only singleton answers.
